title: $117 MILLION HIT: Study Says Spam Filters Cost Republican Fundraisers 142,000 Potential First-Time Donations
body: ​Republican political committees may have lost an estimated $117 million in potential donations after fundraising emails containing WinRed links were disproportionately routed to spam by Gmail, Microsoft Outlook and Yahoo during two periods in 2025, according to a newly published academic study, the NY Post reports. ​ The research, conducted by University of Iowa finance […]
